convert_ldm_checkpoint: convert an original LDM checkpoint and config into a diffusers LDMPipeline and save it
extract_vqvae_weights: extract the VQVAE state dict from an original LDM checkpoint using the first_stage_model prefix
extract_unet_weights: extract the UNet state dict from an original LDM checkpoint using the model.diffusion_model prefix
build_ddim_scheduler: build a DDIMScheduler with scaled linear beta schedule from an LDM config file
save_ldm_pipeline: save an LDMPipeline with VQModel, UNetLDMModel, and DDIMScheduler to a given output path
